description: This file defines the Middleware class for the AWS SDK for PHP, providing various middleware functions used in AWS request processing such as source file handling, validation, request building, signing, retries, and other request/response modifications.

classes.name: Middleware
classes.description: A final class encapsulating various static factory methods to create middleware functions for AWS SDK request lifecycle handling, including source file support, validation, request building, signing, retries, and request/response modifications.

methods.name: sourceFile
methods.description: Creates middleware to handle a command parameter (e.g., 'SourceFile') allowing it to be used to specify data source for uploads by wrapping the request with a LazyOpenStream.

methods.name: validation
methods.description: Creates middleware to validate commands against API models using a Validator, optionally reloading the service definition if modified.

methods.name: requestBuilder
methods.description: Creates middleware to serialize a command into an HTTP request, utilizing a serializer callback.

methods.name: signer
methods.description: Creates middleware to sign requests for commands, supporting various signing mechanisms including token authorization and S3 express signatures.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Creates middleware to invoke a callback function for debugging or logging purposes without modifying the request or command.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Creates middleware to handle request retries based on a provided decider and delay policy, defaulting to exponential backoff.

methods.name: invocationId
methods.description: Creates middleware to add a unique invocation ID header to requests, useful for tracking in Lambda environments.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Creates middleware to automatically add a Content-Type header based on the request URI extension for specified operations.

methods.name: recursionDetection
methods.description: Creates middleware to add a trace ID header in Lambda environments to detect recursive invocations.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Creates middleware to record the history of commands and requests, useful for testing and debugging.

methods.name: mapRequest
methods.description: Creates middleware to apply a transformation function to each request passing through.

methods.name: mapCommand
methods.description: Creates middleware to apply a transformation function to commands passing through.

methods.name: mapResult
methods.description: Creates middleware to apply a transformation function to the result of the command execution.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Creates middleware to measure and record the total time taken for a command's request processing.
